notes: Qal's sole attestation (Ezek.21.17 [21.12 EV], מְגוּרֵי אֶל־חֶרֶב הָיוּ, "[all the princes of Israel] have become those thrown to the sword") is a construct-state participle -- normally excluded by the absolute-state-only participle rule -- kept anyway as an explicit exception (same precedent as H2904/H6140/H3960/H7710/H1110/H1895), since no absolute-state attestation exists at all.
